name: UniDrop
tagline: Campus tools and weekly matching for University of Tsukuba students
description:
UniDrop is a campus app limited to University of Tsukuba students. It combines student-life tools such as graduation-requirement checking and a course-consultation AI with a weekly matching drop: once a week at 21:00 JST, each participant receives one highly compatible person chosen from a 55-question values quiz, so there is no swiping or endless searching.

Sign-up requires a university email address verified with a one-time code, and real names are never shown. Matched members talk in the built-in chat without exchanging personal contact details, with block, report and exclusion settings for safety.

Members who have not set a profile photo are shown a hand-drawn Humation avatar, deterministically generated from their user ID and gender with @humation/core and the Humation 1 asset set, so every member has a consistent face across drop, chat and profile screens.

humation.usage: Default avatars for members without a profile photo, shown across drop, chat and profile screens
